nodes.label: Extension Hooks Mechanism (before_X/after_X)
nodes.rationale: Lets Spec Kit users opt out of extension behavior (e.g. agent context writing) without changing core commands; each core command checks extensions.yml for before_/after_ hooks scoped to that command, skipping silently if the file or hook is absent, so extensions remain optional and decoupled from core logic.

nodes.label: Checklists as 'Unit Tests for Requirements' (English)
nodes.rationale: Checklists validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of requirements writing itself (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) rather than verifying that the implementation behaves correctly; this keeps /speckit-checklist distinct from QA/test-plan tooling and focused purely on spec-writing quality before implementation begins.
